info.title: PEPL API
info.description:
Multi-tenant HR and employee-operations API.

## Conventions

- **Tenancy is implicit.** The company is resolved from the session token. There is no
  tenant id in any path, header or body, and supplying one would have no effect.
- **404, not 403, for scope.** A record belonging to another employee outside the caller's
  data scope returns 404. Confirming that a record exists is itself a disclosure.
- **Stable error codes.** Every error carries `error.code` — switch on that, not on the
  status or the message. `error.requestId` correlates with the server log.
- **Reasons.** Any change that moves money or rewrites history requires a `reason`, and
  the API refuses the request without one.

## Building a UI against this

Call `GET /api/v1/me` first. It returns the caller's `permissions`, data `scope` and the
set of enabled `modules`. Render navigation from that rather than from the role name —
a tenant can define custom roles, so role names are not a reliable switch.

A module the tenant has disabled, or has not purchased, returns 403 `MODULE_NOT_AVAILABLE`.
Hide it rather than showing a disabled teaser.

configSettings.label: Leave management
configSettings.help: Leave types, policies, balances and approvals.

configSettings.label: Optional (restricted) holidays a person may pick per year
configSettings.help: Holidays marked optional in the calendar are off only for people who pick them, up to this many a year. 0 turns the feature off.

configSettings.label: Compensatory off for work on off days
configSettings.help: A present day on a weekly off or holiday credits the CO leave type: a full day at or above the half-day hours, half a day below. Granted nightly from the muster; HR can grant a missed one.

configSettings.label: Comp-off expires after (days)
configSettings.help: An unused comp-off lapses this many days after the day it was earned.

configSettings.label: Leave year starts in
configSettings.help: Month the leave year begins. 4 = April (financial year), 1 = January (calendar year).

configSettings.label: Smallest leave unit
configSettings.help: The smallest amount of leave an employee may apply for.

configSettings.label: Count holidays inside a leave as leave
configSettings.help: When on, a weekly off or company holiday falling BETWEEN two leave days is itself deducted. A non-working day at the start or end of a leave is never charged under either setting.

configSettings.label: Allow negative leave balance
configSettings.help: Let employees apply beyond their balance, going negative instead of unpaid.

configSettings.label: Backdated application limit (days)
configSettings.help: How far into the past a leave application may be dated.

configSettings.label: Leave approval chain
configSettings.help: Who approves a leave request, in order.

configSettings.label: Attendance
configSettings.help: Capture, daily computation, periods and corrections.

configSettings.label: Working week
configSettings.help: Default weekly-off pattern. Override per location or team.

configSettings.label: How a half day is decided
configSettings.help: Explicit: a manager marks it. Hours-derived: worked hours below the threshold auto-mark it.

configSettings.label: Half-day threshold (hours)
configSettings.help: Only used when half days are hours-derived.

configSettings.label: Work from home
configSettings.help: Allow employees to be marked as working remotely.

configSettings.label: Remote days are paid
configSettings.help: Whether a work-from-home day counts as a paid working day.

configSettings.label: Attendance corrections need approval
configSettings.help: none: a person with the permission corrects a day directly. Otherwise the correction is held and applied when the chain approves it (an approval policy for attendance_correction overrides the chain here).

configSettings.label: Company timezone
configSettings.help: An IANA name, e.g. Asia/Kolkata or Asia/Dubai. Decides which calendar day a punch belongs to, when "today" ends for a correction, and how a shift's clock times are read. Change it only between payroll periods.

configSettings.label: Who approves an employee's own attendance request
configSettings.help: A person who forgot to punch, or worked from home without marking it, asks; this chain decides. Always an approval — an employee never edits their own attendance directly. An approval policy for attendance_correction overrides it.

configSettings.label: Work-from-home needs approval
configSettings.help: Off: a WFH request is approved on the spot and the person can punch from anywhere on those days. Field duty always needs approval.

configSettings.label: Work-from-home days allowed per month
configSettings.help: 0 = no cap. Counted across pending and approved requests in the month.

configSettings.label: WFH / field duty approval chain
configSettings.help: Who approves remote and field-duty requests when no approval policy matches.

configSettings.label: Shift swaps need manager approval
configSettings.help: Off: once the colleague accepts, both rosters change on the spot.

configSettings.label: Warn about under-strength shifts this many days ahead
configSettings.help: Shifts with a minimum headcount that the roster does not meet are reported to HR and managers nightly. 0 turns it off.

configSettings.label: Recorded breaks reduce worked time
configSettings.help: When a person records a break, its minutes come off the day. Off: breaks are noted but the day is punch-in to punch-out.

configSettings.label: Ask for a reason on a late punch
configSettings.help: The punch is always accepted; the app then asks why, and the reason shows next to the late mark in the control room and the muster.

configSettings.label: Guard: maximum hours in a day
configSettings.help: The nightly attendance guard flags a day worked longer than this — usually a missed punch-out, sometimes a safety issue.

configSettings.label: Guard: regularisation rate alert (%)
configSettings.help: Flag a manager whose team had more than this share of days regularised over 30 days.

configSettings.label: Close a forgotten punch-out after (minutes past shift end)
configSettings.help: A day with a punch-in and no punch-out is closed at the shift end once this long has passed (12 hours after punch-in for people with no shift), and flagged. 0 turns it off.

configSettings.label: QR / kiosk punch
configSettings.help: A manager's phone or a wall tablet shows a code that changes every minute; scanning it is a punch at that site with no location fix needed.

configSettings.label: Correction window (days)
configSettings.help: How far back HR may correct attendance, within an open period.

configSettings.label: Require location for mobile punch
configSettings.help: Reject a mobile punch without a location fix.

configSettings.label: A day with no attendance record is loss of pay
configSettings.help: Off: a working day nobody recorded is presumed worked and paid (right for companies without a punch system). On: it is unpaid unless corrected. Either way the payroll summary lists such days.

configSettings.label: Late marks that cost half a day
configSettings.help: Every this-many late arrivals in a month (after the shift's grace) deduct half a day of pay. 0 turns the rule off. Applies only to people on a shift.

configSettings.label: Reject punches outside the geofence
configSettings.help: Off: a punch from outside an allowed site is recorded and flagged for the manager. On: it is refused. Applies only to people who have a site; exempt people are never refused.

configSettings.label: Payroll
configSettings.help: Salary structures, statutory deductions, runs and payslips.

configSettings.label: Loss-of-pay basis
configSettings.help: Denominator used to prorate a day of unpaid leave.

configSettings.label: Contribute PF on full wages
configSettings.help: Contribute above the statutory wage ceiling rather than capping at it.

configSettings.label: Net pay variance warning (%)
configSettings.help: Flag an employee whose net pay moves more than this against the previous period.

configSettings.label: Guard: headcount change against last month (%)
configSettings.help: The anomaly guard warns when the number of people paid moves more than this against the previous locked run.

configSettings.label: Guard: total net pay change against last month (%)
configSettings.help: The anomaly guard BLOCKS approval when total net pay moves more than this against the previous locked run, until someone dismisses the finding with a reason.

configSettings.label: Separate approver for payroll
configSettings.help: The person who runs payroll cannot approve or lock the same run.

configSettings.label: Overtime must be approved in advance
configSettings.help: Only pre-approved overtime minutes reach the payroll freeze; unapproved extra hours are recorded but not paid.

configSettings.label: Overtime pay
configSettings.help: none: overtime minutes are recorded on the muster and not paid. single: paid at the ordinary hourly rate (basic ÷ 208 hours). double: at twice the ordinary rate, as the Factories Act requires for covered establishments. Frozen as an OT line on the payslip.

configSettings.label: Salary pay date (day of the following month)
configSettings.help: The day salaries are paid for a month: 1 = 1st of the next month, 7 = 7th. 0 = last working day of the month itself. Used when a period is created automatically; a period's own pay date can still be edited.

configSettings.label: Email payslips when a run is locked
configSettings.help: Sends each person their payslip as a PDF from the company notification mailbox, and keeps a copy on their documents. Needs a sender mailbox under Notifications; without one the payslip is still on their pay history.

configSettings.label: Salary revisions need approval
configSettings.help: none: compensation.write applies a revision directly. Otherwise the revision is held and lands on the record when the chain approves it (an approval policy for compensation — e.g. above a size — overrides the chain here).

configSettings.label: Days in a month for exit settlement
configSettings.help: Leave encashment and notice recovery are paid or recovered per day at monthly pay divided by this. 30 is the convention; some contracts say 26.

configSettings.label: PF establishment code
configSettings.help: From your EPFO registration, for example TNMAS0012345. It names the file the ECR is uploaded against.

configSettings.label: ESI employer code
configSettings.help: 17 digits from your ESIC registration. Needed on the monthly contribution file.

configSettings.label: TAN
configSettings.help: Tax deduction account number, for example CHEA12345B. Every 24Q return is filed against it.

configSettings.label: Professional tax state
configSettings.help: The state whose PT registration you file under, for example TS. Leave blank to use each employee's work state.

configSettings.label: Expenses & travel
configSettings.help: Expense claims against categories with limits, travel requests with advances, reimbursed through payroll.

configSettings.label: Expense approval chain
configSettings.help: Who approves claims and trips when no approval policy matches. Finance last is the usual shape: the manager confirms the spend happened, finance confirms it is payable.

configSettings.label: Projects & timesheets
configSettings.help: Projects people are allocated to, weekly hours booked against them with manager approval, a daily work log, and the approved-hours report.

configSettings.label: Timesheet approval chain
configSettings.help: Who approves a submitted week when no approval policy matches.

configSettings.label: Recruitment
configSettings.help: Requisitions, candidate pipeline, interviews, offers, and conversion of an accepted candidate into an employee with the onboarding checklist.

configSettings.label: Requisition and offer approval chain
configSettings.help: Who approves a hiring requisition and an offer when no approval policy matches. Routed by the hiring manager.

configSettings.label: Performance
configSettings.help: Goals with weights and check-ins, review cycles (self review, manager review, HR calibration, acknowledgement) and performance improvement plans.

configSettings.label: Promotion / increment approval chain
configSettings.help: Who approves a promotion or increment recommendation when no approval policy matches. On approval the designation and compensation change on the effective date, citing the appraisal.

configSettings.label: 360° minimum group size
configSettings.help: Feedback from a relationship group (peers, reports, stakeholders) is shown only when at least this many have answered. Below it the group is withheld, never shown one by one.

configSettings.label: Transfer approval chain
configSettings.help: Who approves a department / location / manager change when no approval policy matches. Applied on the effective date.

configSettings.label: Open a probation review this many days before it ends
configSettings.help: The nightly job opens a review and tells the manager and HR. Confirming issues the confirmation letter and makes the employment permanent; extending moves the end date.

configSettings.label: Assets
configSettings.help: Laptops, phones, SIMs, ID cards, uniforms, PPE, tools, licence seats: a register with issue and return, maintenance, and an exit clearance that will not sign while a leaver still holds an item.

configSettings.label: Surveys & pulse
configSettings.help: Pulse surveys, eNPS and a suggestion box. Anonymous by construction: individual answers are never readable; results are aggregates that withhold small groups.

configSettings.label: Learning & recognition
configSettings.help: A course catalogue with nominations, completion and expiring certifications; mandatory training reaches its whole audience and new joiners automatically. Peer recognition with badges, a company wall and a points balance that can be redeemed or paid out.

configSettings.label: Branding & custom domain
configSettings.help: Your product name, colours and logo on the app, payslips and emails; a custom domain such as people.yourcompany.in. Colours and headers work on every plan; the custom domain is Enterprise.

configSettings.label: Integrations, API keys & webhooks
configSettings.help: API keys that act as a service user with a role; webhooks signed with HMAC on the audit vocabulary; connections to Tally, RazorpayX, Google/Microsoft, SMS, biometric devices and e-sign.

configSettings.label: Administrators must use two-factor authentication
configSettings.help: Org admins, HR admins, payroll admins and finance users are asked to enrol an authenticator app before they can do anything else. Anyone may enrol voluntarily regardless.

configSettings.label: Contribute to network benchmarks
configSettings.help: Share six anonymised operational ratios (attrition, attendance, lateness, leave, overtime, approval turnaround — never pay) under a one-way hash, and see your company against companies of the same type and size. Nothing is shown for a segment with fewer than 10 contributors. Opting out deletes what you contributed.

configSettings.label: Employee helpdesk
configSettings.help: Ticketing for payroll, leave, IT and HR queries.

configSettings.label: Default first-response SLA (minutes)
configSettings.help: Measured in working hours, not wall clock.

configSettings.label: Internal chat
configSettings.help: Direct messages and group conversations between colleagues.

configSettings.label: Group conversations
configSettings.help: When off, people may only exchange direct messages.

configSettings.label: File sharing in chat
configSettings.help: Let people attach documents and images to a message.

configSettings.label: Delete chat history after (days)
configSettings.help: 0 keeps messages indefinitely. A retention job removes older messages.

configSettings.label: Mailbox
configSettings.help: Read and send company email inside PEPL. Each person connects their own mailbox.

configSettings.label: Cache message bodies
configSettings.help: Off by default: PEPL keeps envelopes for the list view and fetches a body on open, so message content is not duplicated into this database.

configSettings.label: Allow sending outside the company
configSettings.help: When off, mail may only be addressed to colleagues.

configSettings.label: Documents
configSettings.help: Offer letters, ID proofs, policies and attachments.

configSettings.label: Largest file (MB)
configSettings.help: Uploads above this size are refused.

configSettings.label: Notifications
configSettings.help: In-app notifications for approvals, leave decisions and announcements.

configSettings.label: Send notifications by email
configSettings.help: Requires a sender mailbox below. Without one, notifications stay in the app.

configSettings.label: Send on WhatsApp
configSettings.help: Approvals, payslips, leave decisions and reminders go to people who opted in with a number, through the provider configured under Company → WhatsApp. Off: nothing leaves.

configSettings.label: Send notifications to devices
configSettings.help: Browser and phone push for people who allowed it on a device. Nothing is sent to a device that did not opt in.

configSettings.label: Send notification email from
configSettings.help: A mailbox already connected in PEPL, for example hr@yourcompany.com. Mail sent from your own domain and server reaches people; mail from an unrelated sender is filtered as spam.

configSettings.label: Keep a former employee's identity for (days)
configSettings.help: How long after the last working day before their personal data may be erased. The default is eight years, the income-tax record retention period; payroll ledger rows are kept regardless — erasure removes the person, not the numbers.

configSettings.label: When a step has nobody to approve it
configSettings.help: A person with no manager on record, or a requester who is their own approver, leaves a step empty. Route to HR sends that step to an HR admin instead; auto-approve lets it through. Field duty, expenses and leave are all affected.

configSettings.label: Remind an approver after (days)
configSettings.help: A pending step older than this gets a daily nudge to the approver; when it is the last step, HR is copied. 0 turns reminders off.

configSettings.label: Escalate a pending approval after (days)
configSettings.help: A step nobody has acted on for this many days is skipped and the request moves to the next approver. 0 turns it off. The last approver is never skipped — an approval by neglect is worse than a wait.
